model_annotation: The graph displays the F1 score performance of three different methods—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—over a series of training epochs. The x-axis, labeled "epoch (次)", represents the number of training iterations and ranges from 0 to 18, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "F1分数", indicates the F1 score and ranges from 0.55 to 0.90, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The red line with square markers, corresponding to the "lattice" method, starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.60 at epoch 2 and increases sharply to about 0.82 by epoch 8, after which it continues to rise more gradually to a final value of approximately 0.87 at epoch 16. The blue line with circular markers, representing the "FLAT" method, begins at an F1 score of approximately 0.80 at epoch 2 and shows a steady increase, reaching a value of approximately 0.89 at epoch 16. The yellow line with triangular markers, representing the "OURS" method, starts at an F1 score of approximately 0.83 at epoch 2 and rises consistently, reaching a final value of approximately 0.91 at epoch 16.
